name: @fyeeme/pi-hooks
description: Claude Code-compatible hooks runner for pi. Reads hooks config (priority: ~/.pi/agent/hooks.json, then project .pi/hooks.json) and maps SessionStart, PreToolUse, and Stop events to pi lifecycle events.
